name: How long does a typical drywall patching repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drywall patching repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a drywall patching repair depends on the size and complexity of the damage. A small hole or crack might take a few hours to complete, including drying times between coats of joint compound. Larger repairs or multiple patches could extend over one to two days, primarily due to the necessary drying time for multiple layers of mud and primer. Professional contractors aim for efficiency while ensuring quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary based on damage size; small patches take a few hours, while larger ones may take one to two days due to drying times.
